observations.semantic_recognizability: The matched three-quarter and detail captures identify a tall wood-and-glass display cabinet with paired doors and open shelves.
observations.silhouette_quality: The target's narrow upright case, restrained crown, and plinth remain in the RoomScale render.
observations.proportion: The candidate validates at 33 x 76 x 18.21 inches against the 33 x 76 x 18-inch brief; width and height are exact and the small depth excess is within the validator's accepted tolerance.
observations.geometric_detail: The detail render resolves full-height paired glazing, three shelves, a meeting stile, three hinges per door, paired brass knobs, and stepped crown/base.
observations.material_realism: The darker walnut and unlit interior follow the approved target more closely than v002's bright, uniformly lit interior; the green room wall darkens the glazing in context.
observations.surface_variation: Wood grain and brighter shelf faces provide restrained variation without adding decorative beadwork.
observations.close_up_quality: The actual Godot close capture shows shelf edges, door rails, hinges, and brass knobs without the target's white studio backdrop.
observations.gameplay_readability: The room-scale capture keeps the cabinet distinct from separate RoomDefinition collectibles and leaves their positions unchanged.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot technical validation passes at exact 33-inch width and 76-inch height; depth is 18.21 inches, within the accepted dimensional tolerance.
observations.art_direction_fit: Dark stained walnut, clear doors, and restrained brass fit the approved target and the Human Room furniture palette.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility import and validation pass with no issues; the production render receipt names display_cabinet-v003.

incumbent_comparison: Against accepted display_cabinet-v002 in the same room and camera, v003 transfers the approved darker walnut, quiet unlit interior, full-height paired doors, three visible shelves, and restrained crown. The incumbent's uniformly illuminated shelf area and heavier front rails move farther from the approved target. Separate room collectibles remain untouched.

joins.evidence: The sash, jambs, rails, and trim resolve as separate fitted components.

hardware.evidence: The real render shows the sash latch.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Keep the target-driven unlit walnut materials and accept the room-specific glass contrast; do not add emissive interior lighting merely to imitate the studio concept backdrop.
